snippet.title: We Are Legion: Rome - Official Creation Process
snippet.description:
Welcome barbarians! We have come here to from Caesar's will!
Caesar's will is to introduce to you, the process of creating our game - "We Are Legion: Rome" 

This is a picture of the awesome barbarian, who has come a long way to stand in the shadow of the Colosseum ready to fight with us - the Legionnaires.


We are Legion: Rome is upcoming singleplayer FPP action-adventure slasher with RPG elements.
Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1120790/We_are_Legion_Rome/
Guide the fate of Kasius who joins Gaius Julius legions in the military campaign against Gauls and
fight on the antique battlefield as regular Legionary. Advance in army ranks, lead well-equipped Roman troops in multiple battles scenarios and hack' slash your way to bloody victory.
You have only one goal - get rich enough to marry the love of Your life. At least at the beginning.

Leave no mercy for those barbarians. FOR THE GLORY OF ROME!

Game is coming on PC, Xbox and PlayStation
Interested? Follow our social media to stay tuned with game development.
